newsitem.title: USA: Justice Dept. urges against SBC long-distance plan.
newsitem.headline: Justice Dept. urges against SBC long-distance plan.

text.p: The Justice Department urged the Federal Communications Commission Friday to reject a bid by regional phone company SBC Communications Inc. to sell long-distance service in Oklahoma.

The department said SBC still needed to carry out legally required steps opening its home territory to competing local services. The law permits regional Bell companies to compete in long distance only if they open up their territory to competition in local service.
"New competitors still don't have a real opportunity to compete in Oklahoma's local telephone markets," said Joel Klein, acting assistant attorney general, calling the application "premature."
Klein said that the department will consider an application once an area has been irreversibly opened to local competition.
SBC filed its application with the FCC on April 11 and the FCC must act on the application by July 10.
